program.section_heading: College Readiness - Reading and Writing Cert (Noncredit)
outcomes: Students will compose paragraphs that demonstrate direction, relevant detail, and clarity on both a paragraph and a sentence level.
Students will demonstrate the ability to use proactive strategies, learning resources, and the composition process to reduce writing frustrations.
Students will demonstrate the ability to comprehend and analyze written passages at a college reading level.
